description:
A BookTuber ascends the throne of the literary realm 🏰

"I was super nervous to take any time away from YouTube to write," @haleypham admits on set of our latest Channeling. "But I feel like I'm very privileged to love two things as much as I do." Haley, who started posting in high school, has become a quintessential BookTuber in the past 5 years – amassing 5 million subscribers and 650 million views across her two channels.

Now, Haley is an author herself. Her debut novel 'Just Friends' became a New York Times bestseller this year – but this achievement is far from the end of her career on YouTube (and only the start of her literary reign). "I will always be interested in something, so I will always be posting videos."

Go behind-the-scenes to learn the legend behind Haley's journey to her first novel, why she'll never stop slaying on YouTube, and even maybe some info about her next book...

Watch and subscribe to Haley's channel here: @haleypham 

Featuring: Brooke Averick
